description: Colorado-specific map layers sourced from Colorado Parks & Wildlife (CPW), Colorado State Land Board (CSLB), and U.S. federal agencies. These layers are merged with the national layer config at runtime.

countyBoundarySource.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau — TIGER/Line Web Map Service
countyBoundarySource.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

groups.label: Colorado Wildlife & Access
groups.description: State Wildlife Areas, Walk-In Access lands, and access-lease parcels managed by Colorado Parks & Wildlife. Data sourced from CPW Open Data.

layers.name: State Wildlife Areas (CPW)
layers.description: Properties CPW manages with public access — chiefly State Wildlife Areas, plus State Trust Land leased by CPW for public hunting and fishing. Hunting permitted subject to current CPW regulations and any area-specific rules.
layers.attribution: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — CPW Managed Properties (public access only)
layers.license: Public Domain — State of Colorado Open Data

layers.name: Walk-In Access Areas (CPW)
layers.description: Private lands enrolled in CPW's Walk-In Access program. Open to public hunting during program season. Enrollment changes annually — verify with CPW before hunting.
layers.attribution: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — Walk-In Access Program
layers.license: Public Domain — State of Colorado Open Data

groups.label: Colorado State Land
groups.description: State Trust Land managed by the Colorado State Land Board (CSLB). Most state trust land is closed to public access — exceptions are parcels under CPW public-access leases.

layers.name: State Trust Land (CSLB)
layers.description: Colorado State Trust Land parcels managed by the Colorado State Land Board. Most are closed (Category 3); parcels with CPW access leases appear as Category 1. Verify before entering.
layers.attribution: Colorado State Land Board — Surface Ownership

groups.label: Colorado Hunting Units
groups.description: Game Management Unit (GMU) boundaries from Colorado Parks & Wildlife. GMUs define where specific license types are valid — they are not land-access boundaries.

layers.name: Game Management Units (GMU)
layers.description: CPW Game Management Unit boundaries for deer, elk, pronghorn, and other big game. Your hunting license is valid in specific GMUs — verify your unit before hunting.
layers.attribution: Colorado Parks & Wildlife — GMU Boundary (Big Game)
layers.license: Public Domain — State of Colorado Open Data

layers.name: GMU Number Labels
layers.description: Number labels for each Game Management Unit, displayed at the unit centroid. Requires GMU boundary layer to be visible.
layers.license: Public Domain — State of Colorado Open Data
